verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, and such a service could plausibly expose an API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack has no Atlas API, no API versioning, and no deprecation policy. All four OpenAPI probe paths returned 404, and the llms.txt and Markdown-docs probes concern documentation access, not versioned APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
